name: frontend-dependencies
body: The frontend capability contract: every language apg ships a scanner for is a frontend with its own build-time dependencies, its own scan-time dependencies, and an engine pin that fixes the language-version ceiling. This group gathers those concepts so the question "to scan language X, what do I need?" has one answer. The per-language frontends are distinct artifacts (`domain.entity.frontend-artifact`); the bundled structural scanner is a single base-package artifact covering the text/config/data formats and has no language-version ceiling (`domain.entity.structural-scanner`, group `domain.group.structural-file-graphing`).
